name: Grass duck
summary: Grass duck, vịt cỏ, is one of the dishes Bản Đôn serves at the stilt-house meal, alongside hill chicken and forest bamboo shoot.
origin: Bản Đôn, Pù Luông. Source: The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 18 Mar 2022.
howToEat: Order it with the village meal at your homestay.
where: Bản Đôn, at the stilt-house table.
seoTitle: Vit co in Pu Luong — grass duck at Ban Don
seoDescription: Vịt cỏ, grass duck, is on the Bản Đôn stilt-house table with hill chicken and forest bamboo shoot.
